studioNotice.headline: Studio Availability & Live Broadcast
studioNotice.message: Full botanical studio & aquascaping showroom are open Monday to Saturday (9:00 AM – 8:30 PM). Walk-ins welcome without prior booking. Sundays are dedicated to weekly nursery rest and tank assembly.
